title: Yeast-Free Catalan Crema Cake
description: A rich and creamy cake using Spanish crema instead of traditional yeast. Perfect for a warm dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together crema, sugar, honey, and orange zest.
Beat in eggs one at a time until well combined.
Sift flour into the bowl and mix until smooth.
Pour batter into prepared pan and smooth top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool in pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
